ValidationRule.description: Exactly one shape per record: date-anchored (Month + Day, no Sort Order), evergreen (Sort Order, no Month/Day), or rule-resolved (Date Rule other than Fixed, no Sort Order, Month/Day as that rule needs). No partial dates or double-anchored records.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Date_Rule__c)), TEXT(Date_Rule__c) = "Fixed"), OR( AND( OR(ISBLANK(Month__c), ISBLANK(Day__c)), NOT(AND(ISBLANK(Month__c), ISBLANK(Day__c))) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Month__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Day__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Sort_Order__c)) ), AND( ISBLANK(Month__c), ISBLANK(Day__c), ISBLANK(Sort_Order__c) ) ) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Date_Rule__c))), TEXT(Date_Rule__c) <> "Fixed", NOT(ISBLANK(Sort_Order__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Use exactly one shape: date-anchored (Month + Day, no Sort Order), evergreen (Sort Order, no Month/Day), or rule-resolved (Date Rule other than Fixed, no Sort Order). No partial dates or double-anchored records.
